_schema.description: Per-family benchmark spec for .github/workflows/benchmark-desktop.yml. Kept out of YAML so it can be edited without touching the workflow, actionlint-diffed independently, and shared with local runs of scripts/benchmarks/run-family.sh.

fields.cmake_target: Ninja/CMake target(s) to build. Multiple targets space-separated.
fields.bench_kind: 'native' when the engine ships a *-bench binary that accepts --runs and --json-out; 'time-wrapped' when we time N invocations of a CLI and take the median wall-clock ourselves.
fields.binary: Path (relative to build/) of the executable to invoke.
fields.s3_prefix: Prefix under s3://$MODEL_S3_BUCKET/qvac_models_compiled/ggml/. All entries in `models` are downloaded to models/<family>/ from this prefix.
fields.models: List of files to fetch. Directory structure is preserved (path segments before the filename become the local subdir).
fields.args: Command-line arguments as a single string. Use ${MODEL_DIR} / ${MODELS_ROOT} placeholders that run-family.sh expands.
fields.notes: Free text; surfaced in the summary table's 'notes' column.

whisper.notes: Whisper's own bench prints per-op timings; the median wall-clock is captured by run-family.sh with time. 'small' has no registry path yet — surfaced as 'not-in-registry'.

parakeet.notes: Uses the shared jfk.wav fixture (10 s clip) to keep runs deterministic.

sortformer.notes: Diarization mode; uses the streaming Sortformer alongside the ASR CTC.

chatterbox.notes: Chatterbox has no dedicated -bench; wall-clock via tts-cli for a fixed 'benchmark run' prompt.

supertonic.notes: Emits JSON via --json-out; median_ms field is authoritative.

parler.notes: Native bench; JSON schema matches supertonic-bench.

cosyvoice.notes: Model-dir mode: bench discovers the six shards under one directory.

audio8.notes: audio8-cli has no --bench flag; wall-clock via time.

lavasr.notes: No q8_0 available in the registry; f16 weights only.

acestep.notes: ~5 GB combined; hosted-linux runners may skip if the per-runner disk budget is exceeded.

minimax.notes: MODEL_MISSING: no S3 registry path yet. Row emitted, execution skipped. Follow-up: upload MiniMax-Music3 GGUFs.
